turns.question: What share of our leads from 1 and 2 October 2026 went on to book?
turns.answer: 30% of the leads created on 1 and 2 October 2026 booked within 30 days of being created (lead-to-booking rate 0.3). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
